Patch Set 23: Code-Review+2
Change has been successfully merged
Why? This is only a dependency for tests and is the same approach we have for most of our C-libraries. What environment does this actually provide a benefit?

FWIW, I did this on a plane to see how hard it would be.


It reduces:
Dependencies Which makes the library itself easier to use in more environments.
Compiles/lint times
Increases the speed at which we can fuzz (really the prior commit does that)


libmctp Is a library that doesn't take a dependency on gtest.
libpldm Is an example that does.

FWIW, I did speak with andrew a little.
Acknowledged
To be fair, `libmctp` isn't _really_ an openbmc repository anymore even though we host it.  It's deprecated for all openbmc use cases.
Fair, was more arguing that this was trying to hit similar systems/goals.
